articles.author: Samuel Adekunle
articles.description:
Google just dropped Antigravity on Nov 18, 2025, their new AI agent-first IDE that's like having a senior engineer as your co-pilot. I'm Samuel Adekunle, your Senior Flutter guy, and in this article, I will guide you through how best to install and configure Google Antigravity for use. We will also explore key concepts of Antigravity, such as Agent Manager, Editor, and Browser, and use my website as a use case with Antigravity.
Alright, quick backstory: Antigravity launched alongside Gemini 3, Google's beast-mode AI model for reasoning and multi-modal tasks. It's free in public preview right now, and download is available for Mac, Windows, or Linux. No cost, generous rate limits on Gemini 3 Pro (resets every 5 hours), and it plays nice with Claude Sonnet 4.5 or even OpenAI's GPT-OSS.
Why the hype? It's 'agentic' - meaning AI agents handle tasks autonomously, like debugging a web app or generating UI from sketches. It's not just code completion; it's task delegation.
Quick features rundown - tailored for us Flutter folks:
Agent Interface: Delegate tasks via natural language in the editor, terminal, or browser preview. How-to: Type '/agent [task]' - e.g., '/agent Fix this Flutter responsive grid for iOS Safari.'
Multi-Model Support: Swap Gemini 3 for Claude if you need creative UI gen. How-to: Settings > Models > Select. Rate limits? Chill for solos.
Proof-of-Work Tracing: Every change logs why the agent did it - audit trail for team collabs. Huge for architecture reviews.
Async Feedback Loop: Agents iterate based on your 'nah, make it more vibe-y' inputs. How-to: Hit 'Refine' and describe.
Cross-Platform Magic: Runs local, no cloud lock-in. Integrates with VS Code extensions if you hybrid.
articles.title: Google Antigravity AI Coding: Building My Portfolio Site from Scratch

2025 is shaping up to be the year of Gemini 3.
Google’s newest flagship model hasn’t just caught up with OpenAI — many developers argue it has leapfrogged GPT-4 in the areas that matter most: reasoning, multimodality, and real-world performance.
At AilonTech, we’ve been closely following the shift… and this one is big.
🔥 A True Leap in Reasoning
Gemini 3 doesn’t just predict text — it thinks.
Developers are reporting major improvements in:
Multi-step logic
Long-code reasoning
Architecture planning
Problem-solving accuracy
“Gemini 3 doesn’t just write code — it understands the intent behind the architecture.”
This qualitative jump is why many experts are calling it a quantum leap, not an incremental upgrade.
🧊 Why OpenAI Is Feeling the Pressure
The Context Window Advantage
Gemini 3 supports an effectively infinite context window for most workflows.
OpenAI models still struggle with long-session retention.
Deep Ecosystem Integration
Google is embedding Gemini 3 into:
Android
Google Cloud
Workspace
Chrome
Pixel devices
This is an OS-level intelligence layer, not just a chatbot.
The Developer “Vibe Shift”
Check X and Reddit — the conversation has changed.
Speed
Accuracy
Tool use
Vision and video tasks
For the first time in years, momentum has shifted away from OpenAI.
🧭 What This Means for Developers & Businesses
If you're building apps or AI products:
Test Gemini 3’s API — costs and latency are extremely competitive.
Explore the multimodal features for video, audio, and vision-based tools.
Consider the ecosystem if you’re planning long-term AI infrastructure.
This is more than a model upgrade.
🔚 Conclusion
OpenAI is still the king.
Google now has the momentum, the ecosystem, and arguably the superior model.
As we move further into 2025, the real question becomes:
Can OpenAI keep up?

A research team from China and Hong Kong believes it has created a solution to context rot. Their new paper introduces general agentic memory (GAM), a system built to preserve long-horizon information without overwhelming the model.
